In fact, I'm so glad Daniel Negreanu wrote Power Hold’em Strategy and perpetuated this “small ball” poker nonsense, because he's one of the only players in the world who can hand read well enough to make that strategy work. Everyone else gets crushed. Take a look at any online grinder’s PokerTracker 4 or Hold'em Manager 2 database and | quarantee that you will not find one person making money by flatting the button wider than 12% of the time — not one!

You have to 3-bet in position to claim the initiative, imply that you have a range advantage, and unleash your skill edge. You will always gather more information by betting and raising than you will by checking and calling. Poker is a war fought with imperfect information! Why are you inhibiting your ability to gather information by flatting the button?
